key_decisions.decision: Retain the direct prohibition rather than Samuel’s question form.
Unfold the elliptical final phrase while preserving the movement among temporary dwellings.
Keep the shift from David building a house to receiving a dynastic house.
Preserve the father-son relationship and leave the predecessor unnamed as the source does.
Retain my house and my kingdom, a consequential distinction from Samuel.
Choose the status reading of the difficult final clause and flag its uncertainty in a note.
Preserve the servant wording and repeated greatness without substituting the parallel account.
Render uncovering the ear as revelation and supply courage for the elliptical found expression.
